subject.title: fix(ios): keep unified voice controls recoverable

question: Should this maintainer-labeled iOS PR be revised to preserve the active Talk stop control over attachment Send and then receive a fresh device/simulator proof review?
rationale: The functional repair is narrow, but the protected maintainer label requires explicit human handling and the current proof does not demonstrate the user-visible recovery paths.

options.title: Request the narrow repair and proof
options.body: Require the composer-priority fix, a focused regression test, and redacted after-fix simulator or device evidence before considering merge.

options.title: Pause the follow-up
options.body: Pause this PR if the unified composer interaction needs a broader owner decision rather than the documented stop-control priority.

recommendation.title: Request the narrow repair and proof
